Coram : DIPAK MISRA*, D.Y. CHANDRACHUD, A.M. KHANWILKAR
National Green Tribunal Act 2010 – s. 11 – To act as Chairperson of tribunal – Held: Section 11 contemplates that the Central Government shall upon the term of the Chairperson of the National Green Tribunal having ended in such an eventuality notify a judicial member to act as Chairperson until a regular appointment is made – Making of an interim arrangement is necessitated in order to enable the acting Chairperson to participate in the selection process for filling up vacancies of members of the NGT – Central Government would abide by the same
Decision Date : 27-03-2018 | Case No : WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) No. 1235/2017 | Disposal Nature : Directions issued | Bench : 3 Judges
